---
title: "About Mithril Metrics"
description: "Short, reproducible case studies on agri-food, water and climate policy."
---

*Mithril Metrics* publishes short, reproducible case studies on agri-food, water, climate and
rural policy. Each one starts from a current policy debate, asks one narrow empirical question,
and answers it with public data in about four hours.

## How each case is built

- **Public data only.** Every number traces to a named dataset and access date.
- **One question, one answer.** The bottom line comes first; caveats are stated plainly.
- **Methods from production and resource economics:** production frontiers, productivity and
  efficiency measurement, water economics and governance, risk and fat tails, panel and
  causal-ML econometrics.
- **Reproducible.** All code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/Mithril-Metrics/mithril-metrics.github.io)
  and runs end to end in R.
- **Neutral.** Policy implications are written as trade-offs, not recommendations.

## Use of AI tools

We use Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic, as a working tool: to help with coding, data retrieval scripts and first drafts of text. Questions, methods, robustness checks and conclusions are our own, every number is reproducible from the published code, and we review all text before it goes online.
